welcome_title: Discover the Hidden Numerical Miracles of the Quran
welcome_subtitle: The most advanced and flexible platform for statistical and numerical analysis of the Holy Quran. Build mathematical models, discover patterns, and explore data like never before.
feature_models_desc: Apply any equation or formula you conceive. The platform dynamically calculates and highlights patterns across Surahs, Ayahs, and Words.
feature_perf_desc: Powered by a separated Node.js Backend and React Frontend. Process complex queries instantly with our robust API.
feature_api_desc: The backend is decoupled, meaning this data can be served to mobile apps, external researchers, or custom platform integrations seamlessly.
tool_unified_desc: Calculate a text, then show its triangle magic square and the words matching its value
tool_jummal_desc: Jummal, Abjad, Ayqagh and their total for any text or verse
tool_tables_desc: The value of each word and the phrase total in the tables you choose
tool_wefq_desc: Study a number in the seven shapes, then build the magic square
tool_number_search_desc: Quran words whose Jummal, Abjad or Ayqagh equals the number
tool_number_study_desc: Digital root, divisors, primality, Fibonacci and decomposition tree
enter_text_f9: Enter text or press F9 to choose a verse
err_no_letters: No valid Arabic letters to calculate
err_select_table: Please select at least one table
err_execute_first: Enter a number and press Execute first
err_select_type: Please select at least one calculation type
err_number_range: Please enter a number between 1 and {{max}}
err_min_triangle: The number must be {{min}} or more
tables_empty: Nothing calculated yet. Enter a text and press Calculate.
ayat_picker_hint: Click to select, Ctrl+click for several, double-click or Enter to confirm
wefq_legend: Green: no fraction, orange: needs a fraction fix, red: below the minimum
search_hint: Enter a number and press Search
ns_prime_rank_ones: Rank among primes with the same last digit
ns_tree_too_big: The tree is large ({{nodes}} nodes), so only the summary is shown
st_FLCs: Surahs starting and ending with it
st_FLVs: Verses starting and ending with it
stats_chars_desc: Occurrences of each of the 28 letters in the Quran (28-letter text)
chars_per_chapter_desc: Count of each letter in each surah. Click a column header to sort
study_char_desc: Choose a letter to see its statistics and distribution across surahs
chapter_verses_desc: Total verses {{verses}}, total words {{words}} (conjunction waw counted as a word)
symmetric_verses_desc: Choose a surah and an axis verse: the verses are placed on a circle and each verse faces its mirror on the other side of the axis (axis+1 with axis-1, and so on), with word and letter totals for each pair
circle_desc: Hover a surah to draw its symmetry line and the total verses of the pair; click to pin the line
Please Select Start Axis: Please select the axis start surah
